src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def separators(lines):
        uniform = {}
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if all(x == line[0] for x in line):
                uniform.setdefault(line[0], []).append(i)
        if not uniform:
            return []
        color = min(uniform, key=lambda c: len(uniform[c]))
        return uniform[color]

    row_seps = separators(grid)
    col_seps = separators([[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)] for c in range(w)])
    row_bounds = [0] + [i + 1 for i in row_seps] + [h + 1]
    col_bounds = [0] + [i + 1 for i in col_seps] + [w + 1]
    row_ranges = [(a, b - 1) for a, b in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:])]
    col_ranges = [(a, b - 1) for a, b in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:])]
    # Drop empty ranges produced by separator lines at an edge.
    row_ranges = [(a,b) for a,b in row_ranges if a < b]
    col_ranges = [(a,b) for a,b in col_ranges if a < b]
    panels = []
    for ri, (rs,re) in enumerate(row_ranges):
        for ci, (cs,ce) in enumerate(col_ranges):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rs,re) for c in range(cs,ce)]
            panels.append((rs,re,cs,ce,cells))
    counts = {}
    for panel in panels:
        for v in panel[4]: counts[v] = counts.get(v,0)+1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    template = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(v != background for v in p[4]))
    trs, tre, tcs, tce, _ = template
    th, tw = tre-trs, tce-tcs
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs,re,cs,ce,_ in panels:
        if re-rs != th or ce-cs != tw:
            continue
        for dr in range(th):
            for dc in range(tw):
                out[rs+dr][cs+dc] = grid[trs+dr][tcs+dc]
    return out
'''
